R54_correction: R54 wrongly judged that no spanning second task was available; stratified by tissue, the Colon (5,789) and Pancreas (3,729) held-out pools both straddle 3,000
key_negative: the threshold learned on two tissues predicts the third tissue's strategy only 50% of the time; in the Colon fold the training tissues had NO positive size while the held-out Colon showed three positive sizes and +10.25 pp at 3,500
confound: the tissue feature was dropped here whereas R51/R53 used it; the two configurations are not separated
C36_narrowing: the predicate is valid only within the population it was learned on; 3,000 is a population-specific empirical value, not a universal constant

register_updates.C38: new, negative: crossover exists in unseen populations but the threshold does not transfer

next_gates: rerun the held-out-tissue test WITH the tissue feature (unknown tissue as a level) to separate the feature confound from a genuine population effect
